lines: מִי מִלְּבַדְּךָ בְּאַהֲבָה קְנַנִי יוֹם אֶחָד
נִכְתַּב שְׁמִי אֶצְלְךָ לֹא אֵירָא גְּנַאי

review: Authored fresh; no settled twin. John 3:30's "He must increase, but I must decrease" is the whole hymn: the three כְּשֶׁ... בַּעֲדִי lines (coming, dying, rising) answer the purchase of 1:3, and the closing refrain repeats increase/decrease as in the Arabic. Glossary: קָנָה for اشترى, צְלָב for الصليب, כָּבוֹד for المجد. The single 14-line stanza is kept as printed, with no padding of the short lines 1:2, 1:9 and 1:14. No chorus field.
